title: Ledger entry
description: One line of ledger.jsonl: a proxy decision. hash = sha256_hex(prev + canonical_json(entry without 'hash')), canonical_json = json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')). The first prev is 64 zeros. args_hash = sha256_hex(canonical_json(args)). See acc.contracts.ledger_hash.

tool.description: Requested tool name; may be unknown to the catalog (then denied).

rule.description: Invariant id or rule name that decided; null when no specific rule applied.
